Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-07

1. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
Google unveiled Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, the newest tier of its multimodal AI model, adding native 15‑second video generation and editing capabilities, improved consistency across outputs, and a 30% lower price point compared with the prior version.

2. GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
OpenAI unveiled GPT‑6 Cyber, an advanced AI system trained to identify security vulnerabilities and propose mitigations, with built‑in alignment controls that keep its actions within authorized scope.

3. Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
Merge adopted OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to automatically review product code, generate marketing copy, plan executive dinners, and draft sales updates.
